verdict.rationale: Ollama documents several first-party ways to serve as the backend for coding agents. It is compatible with the Anthropic Messages API so Claude Code can run on open models, and it supports a subset of the OpenAI API for OpenAI clients. The `ollama launch` command sets up and runs Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex against local or cloud models with no config files. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a coding agent runs well on Ollama, and documentation of which parts of the OpenAI API the 'subset' leaves out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect a coding agent to this product as a working backend

citations.quote: Ollama is now compatible with the Anthropic Messages API, making it possible to use tools like Claude Code with open models.
ollama launch is a new command which sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models. No environment variables or config files needed.
connect Ollama to your existing agents or applications such as `Claude Code`, `OpenClaw`, `OpenCode` , `Codex`, `Copilot`,  and more.
Connect OpenAI clients to Ollama. Ollama supports a subset of the OpenAI API
